card.title: Next Bigger Value in a Circle

a1.cap: nums is circular: after the last element comes the first. For each element, return the first strictly greater value you meet when walking forward around the circle, or -1 if there is none.
a1.say: nums is circular: after the last element comes the first. For each element, return the first strictly greater value you meet when walking forward around the circle, or minus 1 if there is none.

lines: nums is circular: after the last element comes the first. For each element, return the first strictly greater value you meet when walking forward around the circle, or -1 if there is none.

a1.cap: For example, with nums = [1,2,1], the answer is [2,-1,2].
a1.say: For example, with nums equals 1, 2, 1, the answer is 2, -1, 2.

a1.cap: Walk the indexes twice around the circle. Keep a stack of indexes still waiting for a bigger value; when a bigger value arrives, it answers them.
Only push indexes during the first lap, so each one waits at most one full circle.
Let's walk through it with nums = [2,1,3,1].
a1.say: Let's walk through it with nums equals 2, 1, 3, 1.

a1.cap: 3 is the next bigger value for an index that was waiting.

Time complexity is O(n) and extra space is O(n).
a1.say: Time complexity is O of n and extra space is O of n.
